title: Jerusalem is told to bear her shame for outdoing her sisters
speaker: the Lord through Ezekiel
note: Imperatives 'receive your torment… be ashamed'; cf. 36:32 call to shame (ot-ezekiel-v36-32). Borderline sentence of judgment.

title: Ezekiel is told to tell Israel the parable of the eagles
speaker: the Lord
note: Opening charge; only the explanation (17:11–15, AUD-30-17-11) is recorded; 17:3 has a Study Context record only.

title: God forbids Israel's sour-grapes proverb: the soul that sins will die
speaker: the Lord
recipient: Ezekiel, for the house of Israel
note: Outside candidate list; 18:1–4 has no record. Cf. the 12:23 proverb kept as Study Context (ot-ezekiel-v12-23).

title: God desires the wicked to turn and live, not die
speaker: the Lord
note: Same saying as 33:11 (and 18:32); link as Additional Scripture.

title: Ezekiel is told to take up a lament over Israel's rulers
speaker: the Lord
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: 19:2 has only a Study Context record; the charge to lament is unrecorded.

title: Ezekiel is told to confront the elders with their fathers' lawlessness
speaker: the Lord
note: Distinct from the later charge at 20:27 (ot-ezekiel-v20-27).

title: God tells the house of Israel to remove their idolatrous practices
speaker: the Lord through Ezekiel
note: Present call to put away practices; 20:7 (ot-ezekiel-v20-7) only recalls the Exodus generation's command.

title: Ezekiel is told to prophesy against the forest of the Negev
speaker: the Lord
note: 21:3 has only a Study Context record; the commission itself is unrecorded.

title: Ezekiel is told to mark out two roads for Babylon's sword
speaker: the Lord
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Symbolic act: a signpost where the road forks toward Rabbah and Jerusalem.

title: Ezekiel is told to wail because the sword has come on Israel
speaker: the Lord
note: Outside candidate list: 21:19 repeats the sign: prophesy and strike hand upon hand.

title: Ezekiel is told to prophesy the sword against the Ammonites
speaker: the Lord
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life

title: Ezekiel charges Jerusalem with bloodshed and idolatry
speaker: the Lord
note: 22:2 holds the charge itself: 'display all her lawless deeds to her, and say'.

title: Ezekiel is told to indict the land and its corrupt leaders
speaker: the Lord
note: Outside candidate list; the oracle 22:23–31 against leaders, priests and people has no record.

title: The oracle summons a crowd against Oholah and Oholibah
speaker: the Lord
note: 23:47 continues the same imperatives: stone them and pierce them.

title: Ezekiel is told not to mourn publicly for his wife's death
speaker: the Lord
note: Sign-act wholly unrecorded; 24:16–17 outside candidate list; 24:18 records his obedience; 24:22–24 applies the sign to Israel.

title: Ezekiel is told to record the day Babylon besieged Jerusalem
speaker: the Lord
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list; distinct from the cauldron-parable charge at 24:3 (ot-ezekiel-v24-3).

title: Ezekiel is told to prophesy against the Ammonites
speaker: the Lord
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list; 25:3 has only a Study Context record (ot-ezekiel-v25-3).

title: Ezekiel addresses Tyre as a proud center of maritime trade
speaker: the Lord
note: Outside candidate list: 27:2 holds the charge 'take up a lament over Tyre'.

title: Ezekiel is told to confront the ruler of Tyre's claim to divinity
speaker: the Lord
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list; the oracle 28:1–10 has no record.

title: Ezekiel is told to lament over the ruler of Tyre
speaker: the Lord
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: The lament 28:11–19 has no record.

title: Ezekiel is told to prophesy against Sidon
speaker: the Lord
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: 28:22 has only a Study Context record (ot-ezekiel-v28-22).

title: Ezekiel is told to prophesy against Pharaoh and all Egypt
speaker: the Lord
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: 29:3 has only a Study Context record (ot-ezekiel-v29-3).

title: Ezekiel is told to proclaim the Lord's day against Egypt
speaker: the Lord
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list; 30:1–19 has only a Study Context record at 30:15.

title: Ezekiel is told to address Pharaoh and his multitude
speaker: the Lord
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list; chapter 31 has no record.

title: Ezekiel is told to lament over Pharaoh, king of Egypt
speaker: the Lord
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: 32:4 has only a Study Context record (ot-ezekiel-v32-4).

title: Ezekiel is told to lament Egypt's descent into the pit
speaker: the Lord
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list; the second lament (32:17–32) has only a Study Context record at 32:21.

title: Shepherds should feed the flock, not themselves
speaker: the Lord through Ezekiel
note: Indictment states leaders' duties: feed, strengthen, heal, bind up, seek the lost. Only the commission (34:2) is recorded.

title: Ezekiel is told to prophesy against Mount Seir
speaker: the Lord
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list; 35:3 has only a Study Context record (ot-ezekiel-v35-3).

title: Ezekiel addresses Israel's land after neighboring peoples dishonor it
speaker: the Lord
note: 36:1 opens the same charge: 'prophesy concerning Israel's mountains and say'.

title: Ezekiel is told to speak the Lord's word over the dry bones
speaker: the Lord
note: 37:5–6 is the word he must speak; 37:7 records that he prophesied as commanded.

title: Ezekiel is told to call the breath from the four winds
speaker: the Lord
note: 37:10 records his obedience: 'I prophesied as He commanded me'.

title: Ezekiel is told to write Judah and Joseph on two staffs
speaker: the Lord
note: 37:17 'join them as one staff' completes the sign; 37:18–20 tells him how to explain it.

title: Ezekiel is told to deliver the Lord's warning to Gog
speaker: the Lord
note: 38:2 holds the charge: 'set your face against Gog… and prophesy against him'.

title: Ezekiel is told to prophesy against Gog a second time
speaker: the Lord
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list (context verse); a separate oracle from 38:2–3 and 38:14, which are recorded separately.

title: Appointed men search out and bury the dead to cleanse the land
speaker: the Lord through Ezekiel
note: Foretold procedure: seven months of burial, permanent searchers, markers set by bones. Prediction rather than command.

title: The oracle summons birds and beasts to a feast after judgment
speaker: the Lord
note: 39:18–20 continue the same summons ('you will eat… drink').

title: Ezekiel is told to observe the temple vision and declare it
speaker: the man with the measuring reed
note: Opening charge of the temple vision; cf. the later charges at 43:10–11 and 44:5, recorded separately.

title: Inner-court chambers are assigned to priests keeping house and altar
speaker: the man with the measuring reed
note: Outside candidate list; also names Zadok's sons as those who draw near. Cf. 42:13–14 (AUD-30-42-13).

title: God will dwell with Israel when they put away idolatry and bloodshed
speaker: the Lord (a voice from the house)
recipient: Ezekiel, for the house of Israel
note: 43:7–8 states the same requirement: Israel will no longer profane My name by prostitution and murder.

title: Levites who served idols may not serve as priests
speaker: the Lord through Ezekiel
note: Outside candidate list; only inside broad record ot-ezekiel-v44-13 (44:13–21). 44:14 restates the 44:11 duties.

title: Only Zadok's sons may approach to offer fat and blood
speaker: the Lord through Ezekiel
recipient: Israel; the Levitical priests, the sons of Zadok
note: Outside candidate list; inside broad record ot-ezekiel-v44-13. Same restriction at 40:46, 43:19 and 48:11.

title: Priests wear linen, not wool, when ministering in the inner court
speaker: the Lord through Ezekiel
note: Outside candidate list; inside broad record ot-ezekiel-v44-13. Echoes Exodus 28:42–43 (C0301) but adds the wool ban.

title: Priests change their ministering garments before going out to the people
speaker: the Lord through Ezekiel
note: Outside candidate list; same rule as 42:14. Link as Additional Scripture.

title: Priests must not shave their heads and must keep them covered
speaker: the Lord through Ezekiel
note: Outside candidate list; inside broad record ot-ezekiel-v44-13. Echoes Leviticus 21:5 (C0655), which concerns mourning.

title: Priests drink no wine when entering the inner court
speaker: the Lord through Ezekiel
note: Outside candidate list; repeats Leviticus 10:9. Link as Additional Scripture.

title: The ruler's Sabbath burnt offering: six lambs and a ram
speaker: the Lord through Ezekiel
note: Outside candidate list; inside broad record ot-ezekiel-v46-1 (46:1–13). Differs from Numbers 28:9–10 (C0928); cf. 45:17.

title: The new-moon offering: a calf, six lambs and a ram
speaker: the Lord through Ezekiel
note: Outside candidate list; inside broad record ot-ezekiel-v46-1. Differs from Numbers 28:11–15 (C0929).

title: Festival worshippers leave by the opposite gate; the ruler goes with them
speaker: the Lord through Ezekiel
recipient: the ruler and the people of the land
note: Outside candidate list; inside broad record ot-ezekiel-v46-1, whose title covers only the east gate.

title: Festival grain offerings: a cake for each calf and ram
speaker: the Lord through Ezekiel
note: Outside candidate list; inside broad record ot-ezekiel-v46-1.

title: The east gate is opened for the ruler's freewill offering
speaker: the Lord through Ezekiel
note: Outside candidate list; inside broad record ot-ezekiel-v46-1; the gate is shut again after he leaves.

title: A grain and oil offering accompanies the morning sacrifice
speaker: the Lord through Ezekiel
note: Outside candidate list: 46:13 prescribes the daily morning lamb itself, now only in broad record ot-ezekiel-v46-1.

title: Daniel asks to be tested on legumes and water, not royal food
speaker: Daniel
note: Request to avoid defilement (1:8, outside candidate list) and the ten-day test (1:12–13); nothing in 1:6–21 is recorded.

title: Nebuchadnezzar examines the four youths and appoints them rulers
speaker: King Nebuchadnezzar
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Includes the king's order to bring them in (1:18).

title: Nebuchadnezzar demands that his wise men tell and interpret his dream
speaker: King Nebuchadnezzar
recipient: the incantation-singers, magi, sorcerers and Chaldeans
note: Summons and demand under threat of death; distinct from the execution decree (2:13, ot-daniel-v2-13).

title: The Chaldeans ask the king to tell them his dream
speaker: the Chaldeans
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Ordinary request, repeated in 2:7.

title: The decree to execute Babylon's wise men
speaker: King Nebuchadnezzar
note: 2:12 is the king's order itself; 2:14 names Arioch as the one ordered to carry it out.

title: Daniel asks the king for time to disclose the dream
speaker: Daniel
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list; reported request.

title: Daniel calls his companions to fast and seek God's help
speaker: Daniel
note: Outside candidate list; 'He called for fasting and supplication': a reported call to prayer.

title: Nebuchadnezzar orders sacrifices and libations offered to Daniel
speaker: King Nebuchadnezzar
note: Outside candidate list; reported order.

title: The accusers cite the king's decree to worship the image
speaker: the Chaldean accusers
note: 3:11 is the decree's penalty clause (the blazing furnace).

title: Nebuchadnezzar summons all officials to the golden image's dedication
speaker: King Nebuchadnezzar
recipient: the satraps, governors and officials of every nation
note: Outside candidate list; reported summons preceding the herald's decree (3:4–6, ot-daniel-v3-4).

title: Nebuchadnezzar orders the three to bow to the image or burn
speaker: King Nebuchadnezzar
note: Personal ultimatum, distinct from the general decree (3:4–6) and the accusers' citation (3:10).

title: Nebuchadnezzar orders the furnace heated and the three thrown in
speaker: King Nebuchadnezzar
note: The order is recalled at 3:22 and 3:24.

title: Nebuchadnezzar calls the three to come out of the fire
speaker: King Nebuchadnezzar
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list; direct command.

title: Nebuchadnezzar decrees death for blaspheming the God of the three
speaker: King Nebuchadnezzar
note: Royal decree in 3:96 (context verse, outside candidate list); no record covers 3:91–97.

title: Nebuchadnezzar gives the three authority over the whole country
speaker: King Nebuchadnezzar
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life

title: The dream's messenger orders the tree cut down
speaker: Daniel, recounting the angel's command
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Daniel's interpretation restates the angel's order of 4:14–16.

title: An angel tells Nebuchadnezzar to serve and glorify the Most High
speaker: an angel from heaven
note: Direct heavenly command at his restoration (Old Greek).

title: Nebuchadnezzar condemns to death anyone who speaks against God
speaker: King Nebuchadnezzar
note: Royal pronouncement with his vow of sacrifice for himself and his people; distinct from the circular letter (4:37b, ot-daniel-v4-37b).

title: King Baltasar orders God's temple vessels brought for his banquet
speaker: King Baltasar (Belshazzar)
note: Wicked ruler's order profaning God's holy vessels; chapter 5 has no record.

title: Baltasar decrees a reward for whoever interprets the writing
speaker: King Baltasar (Belshazzar)
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list; summons plus 'the king issued a decree': purple, gold necklace, a third of the kingdom.

title: Baltasar summons the queen about the writing
speaker: King Baltasar (Belshazzar)
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Reported summons.

title: Baltasar asks Daniel to interpret the writing, promising high rank
speaker: King Baltasar (Belshazzar)
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Request phrased as a question with a promised reward; fulfilled at 5:29.

title: Baltasar gives Daniel authority over a third of the kingdom
speaker: King Baltasar (Belshazzar)
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list; appointment to office, like 2:48–49 (AUD-31-2-48).

title: Darius orders his kingdom to worship Daniel's God
speaker: King Darius
note: 6:28 completes the decree with Darius's own pledge and its reason.

title: Darius appoints satraps and three leaders, Daniel among them
speaker: King Darius
recipient: 127 satraps and three leaders including Daniel
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list; includes the king's plan to set Daniel over the whole kingdom (6:4–5).

title: Darius orders Daniel thrown into the lions' pit
speaker: King Darius
note: Outside candidate list; enforcement of the decree recorded at 6:10 (ot-daniel-v6-10).

title: A voice charges Gabriel to explain the vision to Daniel
speaker: a human voice from the Ulai
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list; heavenly commission of an angel.

title: The messenger reassures and strengthens Daniel
speaker: the angelic messenger
note: Reported: 'he told me to be strong and take courage', the same charge as 10:19.

title: Blessed is the one who perseveres to the end of the days
speaker: the angelic messenger
note: Beatitude commending endurance to the 1,335th day.

title: The witnesses lay hands on the accused's head
speaker: the law (Leviticus 24:14), applied by the elders
note: Narrative enactment of the witnesses' rite of Leviticus 24:14, here by false witnesses.

title: An angel, as commanded, gives young Daniel a spirit of understanding
speaker: the Lord (reported)
note: Outside candidate list; reported commission of an angel, like Bel 1:34 (ot-daniel-bel-v1-34).

title: The false witnesses receive the penalty they intended for Susanna
speaker: the law (Deuteronomy 19:19), applied by the assembly
note: 'As the law prescribes, they did to them what they had wickedly plotted': explicit application of Deuteronomy 19:19.

title: Daniel challenges the unexamined verdict and separates the witnesses
speaker: Daniel
recipient: the assembly and the two elders
note: Outside candidate list: 1:54 questions the first elder (cf. the 1:58 record); 1:56 orders the second brought.

title: Daniel asks the king for authority to kill the dragon
speaker: Daniel
note: Request granted in 1:26 ('It is granted to you').

summary: Ezekiel 16-48 lacks most of its oracle commissions and itemized temple laws; Daniel lacks many royal orders, appointments and the 3:96 decree.
